name: browser-control-firefox
description: Control Mozilla Firefox: tabs, history, web content and page interaction
long_description:
This MCP server provides AI assistants with access to the browser's tab management, browsing history, page search, webpage text content, and direct page interaction through a local MCP (Model Context Protocol) connection.

How much of the web the server may touch is chosen in the extension's toolbar popup: every page except a domain deny list, or only the tabs and sites the user authorized. Clicking, typing and JavaScript execution are separate switches that can be turned off at any time, and every interaction is drawn on the page so the user can see what is being touched.

**Note:** This extension requires a separate Firefox add-on component. This is a fork with page interaction added, so the add-on has to be built from the fork's repository rather than installed from addons.mozilla.org. Build it, load it, then copy the secret key from the add-on settings page and paste it into this extension's configuration.

extension_secret.title: Firefox Extension Secret
extension_secret.description: The secret key provided by the Firefox extension

port.title: Extension Port
port.description: The port that the MCP server will use to communicate with the Firefox extension (default is 8089)

tools.name: open-browser-tab
tools.description: Open a new tab in the browser

tools.name: navigate-browser-tab
tools.description: Send an open tab to another URL, keeping the same tab

tools.name: close-browser-tabs
tools.description: Close tabs in the browser

tools.name: list-open-tabs
tools.description: Get the list of open tabs in the browser

tools.name: get-recent-browser-history
tools.description: Get the list of recent browser history

tools.name: read-page
tools.description: Read a page or one element of it: text and interactive elements in document order, each element stamped with a ref the interaction tools accept; a large page read as a whole returns an outline of its regions instead

tools.name: find-text-in-page
tools.description: Find and highlight text in a browser tab, returning a ref and the surrounding text for each match

tools.name: capture-tab-screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the visible area of a browser tab (requires per-tab user consent)

tools.name: list-page-media
tools.description: List the images, videos and audio a page shows, with URLs and original sizes

tools.name: read-page-image
tools.description: Read an image a page shows as the original file, with the page's cookies (off by default)

tools.name: click-page-element
tools.description: Click an element in a browser tab, or with action hover only move the pointer over it, by snapshot ref or CSS selector

tools.name: type-into-page-element
tools.description: Type text into an input, textarea or contenteditable element, optionally submitting the form

tools.name: press-key-in-tab
tools.description: Dispatch a key press in a browser tab, including editing shortcuts such as Control+A, Control+C and the caret keys

tools.name: scroll-browser-tab
tools.description: Scroll a browser tab by a distance, to its edges, or until an element is centred

tools.name: select-page-option
tools.description: Choose one or more options in a select element

tools.name: wait-for-page
tools.description: Wait for a CSS selector to reach a state, or with no selector block until the text of the page or one element changes and return only what arrived

tools.name: execute-javascript-in-tab
tools.description: Run JavaScript in a browser tab and return the value of its last expression

tools.name: drag-page-element
tools.description: Drag one element and drop it on another, addressed by ref or selector

tools.name: upload-files-to-page-element
tools.description: Attach files from the user's computer to a file input, by path (off by default)

tools.name: download-file-from-page
tools.description: Save a file a page shows into the browser's downloads folder, by ref or listed URL (off by default)

tools.name: resize-browser-window
tools.description: Resize the window that holds a tab

tools.name: read-network-requests
tools.description: List the HTTP requests a tab made since its page started loading, without bodies

tools.name: run-browser-actions
tools.description: Run several browser tools in one call, in order, stopping at the first failure
